title: Delving into Multilingual Ethical Bias: The MSQAD with Statistical Hypothesis Tests for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper's core focus is on validating and comparing the 'ethical biases' of Large Language Models. It introduces a new dataset, the Multilingual Sensitive Questions & Answers Dataset (MSQAD), which is used specifically to evaluate models on socially sensitive topics (such as Human Rights, Women's Rights, and Refugees) based on the morality and informativeness of their responses.
